questions.questionTextEn: ‘Death V alley’ situated in South California in the U.S.A is an example of which of the following ?
questions.questionTextHi: [U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2012] ‘Death V alley’ situated in South California in the U.S.A is an example of which of the following ?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (D) Rift Valley. A rift valley is formed on a divergent plate, deepened by the forces of erosion. A rift valley is a linear-shaped low land between several highlands or mountain ranges created by the action of a geological rift or fault. Death Valley mainly in California, USA, is an example of such a rift valley. [U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2012]

questions.questionTextEn: The Death Valley is known as ‘Devil’s Golf Course’ is located in–
questions.questionTextHi: [U.P.P.C.S. (Mains) 2014] The Death Valley is known as ‘Devil’s Golf Course’ is located in–
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A) U.S.A. The Death Valley is popularly known as “Devil’s Golf Course” is located in Death Valley National Park of the Northern Mojave Desert of United States of America. This Park is situated mainly in California. The Devil’s Golf Course is a large salt pan on the floor of Death Valley. [U.P.P.C.S. (Mains) 2014]

questions.questionTextEn: The Death Valley is Known for its –
questions.questionTextHi: [U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2005] The Death Valley is Known for its –
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A) Excessive Heat (Hotness). Death Valley is located mainly in the State of California (U.S.A). This is the lowest place of North America (-86 meter below the sea level) and second lowest to Laguna Del Carbon (-105 meter) of Argentina in the Western hemisphere. During summer maximum temperature reaches up to 56.70 C in this region.This is the hottest and most arid valley of the U.S.A. [U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) 2005]

questions.questionTextEn: Which of the following landforms is found in Karst region?
questions.questionTextHi: [Jharkhand P.C.S. (Mains) 2016] Which of the following landforms is found in Karst region?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B) Sink hole. A doline (or sinkhole as it is more commonly called in North America) is a natural enclosed depression found in Karst landscapes. It is the most common land form in Karst areas. Significantly, they are described as small to medium sized closed depressions, ranging from metres to tens of metres in both diameter and depth. [Jharkhand P.C.S. (Mains) 2016]
